notes.title: Major Update: Missing Pieces Bug Fixed
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the delay on this fix. Today's update ensures the pieces load properly and the board is playable again.[/p][p][/p][p]Please update the game and try a new match. If anything still looks off, please let us know so we can follow up quickly.[/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to ◉_◉ for sharing a community workaround guide that helped us confirm the solution.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support,[/p][p]- Deep Green Games leam[/p]

notes.title: The BOT.VINNIK you’ve been waiting for is finally here!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, comrades!
[/h3]
You may have noticed we’ve been radio silent for a while—but there’s a good reason: we’ve spent the last few years working on the most ambitious BOT.VINNIK project to date!

🎉 BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy is now live on Steam:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/[/url]

This new game is the culmination of everything we’ve learned from the previous titles in the series. Alongside a brand-new visual style, it features:
[list]

[*] A reworked scoring system

[*] Structured progression across lessons

[*] Multiple difficulty levels

[*] A growing platform powered by future DLCs

[*] And even a beginner mode for those who don’t know how the knight moves yet

[/list]
Of course, BOT.VINNIK’s trademark sarcasm and brutal honesty are back and sharper than ever.

A free demo will be released soon — until then, check out the trailer and hit that Wishlist button to let BOT.VINNIK know you’re still worthy of being called "comrade."
(YouTube™ embed: “BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy – Reveal Trailer”)

Thanks for all the support over the years!
See you at the Academy.


Rodrigo & Eduardo
Deep Green Games

notes.title: Puzzle Randomizer Fix
notes.content: We fixed an issue regarding the puzzle randomizer that surfaced after the last major update.

notes.title: Traditional Chess Pieces!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471878/ac4664ad5e4109ce543616e449844b9bf878d813.png[/img]

Attention all chess players! We have some exciting news for you. Your feedback has been heard and we're thrilled to announce that traditional chess pieces are now available for selection in our game! This update means that you can now choose between traditional chess pieces or the chess pill pieces that are already in the game.

If you're someone who prefers a faster board reading experience, the traditional chess pieces are perfect for you. But if you're someone who loves the unique design of the chess pill pieces and how they fit in with the game's environment, you can stick with them.

Who knows, this update might just be the key to helping you climb up the leaderboard! So don't wait any longer, update the game now and see how these new pieces can enhance your chess experience. Let's see who will come out on top with these new options!

notes.title: More puzzles!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Over 600 new puzzles have been added to the starting levels.
[*] Improved Puzzle Randomizer, which now takes previously played puzzles into account.
[/list]
[b]That means you can now play a lot more before repeating a single puzzle![/b]

notes.title: First Major Update is here!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Relax mode added[/b]. Feel like "relaxing" a little? We got you covered with this less challenging new mode. This mode also includes its own leaderboard.
[*] [b]In-game leaderboard[/b]: You don't have to leave the game to check how your score compares to other players.
[*] [b]UI improvements[/b]: You can now select the piece while the opponent is still moving, so you don't lose precious time waiting (thanks Trin, for the feedback). We also added separate visual indicators for when the pill is available and for when the pill can be used. And the animations are now smoother.
[*] [b]Minor bug fixes[/b].
[/list]
